$10/Day Facebook Boost Strategy for Real Estate Leads
The $10/day Facebook boost strategy real estate agents use to get local leads on a small budget that scales.
Is $10/day enough for a Facebook boost?

Yes. $10/day for 7 days gives you $70 of targeted local reach per week. For real estate agents targeting a specific city, this is enough to reach thousands of local residents. The goal isn’t mass reach — it’s consistent visibility to the right people in your market.
Should I boost every Facebook post?

No. Only boost your best-performing content — posts that already got organic engagement. And always boost content with your face on it. People remember faces, not logos. Rotate to a different post each week to keep your content fresh.
How do I target my local area in a Facebook boost?

When you click Boost Post, select “People in my local area” under Audience. This tells Facebook to show your post to users who physically live near you. You can also customize the radius to target specific neighborhoods or cities.
What’s better: Facebook ads or Facebook boosts?

For local real estate agents building brand awareness, boosts are simpler and equally effective. Facebook ads require complex targeting, landing pages, and conversion funnels. Boosts let you put your best content in front of local people for $10/day without the complexity.
How long does it take to see results from Facebook boosts?

You’ll see increased profile visits and engagement within the first week. Real authority-building takes 60–90 days of consistent weekly boosts. By month three, local residents will recognize your face and start reaching out when they’re ready to buy or sell.

⚡ Quick Answer

The $10/day Facebook boost strategy works by boosting one piece of content per week to people in your local area — not chasing viral reach. Click Boost Post, choose “People in my local area,” set $10/day for 7 days, then stop. Next week, boost a different piece of content. This puts fresh content in front of new local people every single week for just $70.

This isn’t about millions of views. It’s about the right eyeballs — the parents, the homeowners, the people who might actually move. When those people see your face every week, you become the agent they think of first.

The Exact $10/Day Facebook Boost Strategy

When you post on Facebook, don’t just boost and hope. There’s a specific sequence that makes this work, and it takes less than 2 minutes to set up.

  1. Click Boost Post

    Pick a post that already has some organic engagement — a video or graphic that resonated with your existing audience.

  2. Choose Your Audience

    Select “People in my local area.” This is the critical step most agents skip. You’re telling Facebook: show this to people who actually live here.

  3. Set the Budget

    Set $10 a day. Run it for 7 days. That’s $70 per week to be the most visible agent in your city.

  4. Stop After 7 Days

    Don’t let it run indefinitely. After 7 days, stop the boost. Next week, boost a DIFFERENT piece of content. Fresh content hits new people every single week.

“You’re not telling Facebook to chase random views. You’re telling Facebook: show this to people who actually live here. Local content + local distribution = local authority.”
— Trent Stonehouse, CEO of VEXI (formerly Social Realtr)

The One Rule: Only Boost Content with Your Face

Only boost videos or graphics with your face on them. This is non-negotiable. People don’t remember logos. They remember faces.

When a homeowner in your city sees your face on their feed three weeks in a row, something happens in their brain. You become familiar. You become the agent they “know.” When they’re ready to buy or sell, your face is the one that comes to mind — not the agent with the logo-only posts they scrolled past.

Here’s what to boost:

  • Videos of you talking to camera about local market updates, neighborhood tips, or buyer/seller advice
  • Graphics with your headshot alongside market data or tips
  • Listing tour videos where you’re on camera walking through the property

What NOT to boost: stock photos, text-only graphics, or branded posts without your face. These build zero recognition. You’re investing $10/day to build your brand, not a template’s brand.

Why This Works Better Than Facebook Ads

This isn’t about reach. It’s about relevance. Traditional Facebook ads require complex targeting, landing pages, and conversion funnels. The $10/day boost strategy skips all of that and focuses on one thing: making sure local people see your face every week.

Here’s the math:

  • $10/day x 7 days = $70 per boost
  • $70 x 4 weeks = $280/month for consistent local visibility
  • $280/month vs. $500+/month for Zillow leads that ghost you

The difference? Zillow leads don’t know you. Boosted content builds familiarity over time. When someone sees your face 10 times before they even need an agent, you’re not cold-calling — you’re the person they already “know.”

It takes an average of 7–12 touchpoints before a prospect engages with a brand. Weekly boosted posts create those touchpoints automatically within your local market, building the familiarity that converts strangers into clients.

Source: Marketing Profs, Brand Touchpoint Research, 2025

The Weekly Rotation System

The key to this strategy is rotation. Don’t boost the same post for a month. Each week, pick a different piece of content. This ensures fresh content hits new people in your city every single week.

Here’s a sample monthly rotation:

  • Week 1: Boost a market update video for your city
  • Week 2: Boost a listing tour or neighborhood walkthrough
  • Week 3: Boost a tip video (buyer advice, seller tips, first-time homebuyer guide)
  • Week 4: Boost a client success story or testimonial video

Each boost runs for exactly 7 days at $10/day. When one ends, start the next. This creates a rhythm where your local market sees a new piece of your content every single week — building authority, trust, and top-of-mind awareness over time.
